oneLine: Ganesh Benzoplast sells liquid storage and rail logistics businesses for ₹1,154 crore.

sources.title: Ganesh Benzoplast to sell liquid storage, rail logistics businesses for ₹1,154 crore

synopsis: Ganesh Benzoplast Ltd has signed definitive agreements to sell its liquid storage tank and rail logistics businesses to Cisternina Logistics Private Ltd for an aggregate consideration of ₹1,154 crore. The transaction covers the liquid storage tank business at terminals in Jawaharlal Nehru Port, Cochin and Goa on a slump sale basis, and the rail logistics business at Daund through the sale of Infrastructure Logistic Systems Ltd's shareholding in ILSL Rail Logistics Private Ltd. Completion is subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals and is expected to take place in tranches over the next 18 to 24 months. Ganesh Benzoplast plans to use the proceeds to expand its capacity for manufacturing chemicals, food preservatives, and lube oil additives, chemical trading, higher-value EPC projects, and will also consider corporate actions including a buyback.
